answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to maintain custody of 500 unique data shards per cycle to verify active storage utility. A verifier requests unpredictable file segments, which the agent must forge into a response within a set zephyr window to ensure live retrieval. An honest agent pays for the baseline disk access, whereas 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times the infrastructure cost, as the cloud nebula of audit requests forces each to hold independent, non-overlapping shards. Evidence of retrievable failures triggers an immediate loss of deposited capacity, with no refund granted for collusion.
